# Utilities whose corpus does not yet pass on Darwin.
#
# The macOS lane runs the WHOLE catalogue and compares the set of test
# functions that failed against this list. A name that fails and is not here
# fails the lane — that is the ratchet, and it is what stops the Darwin
# result from drifting while the divergences are worked through.
#
# Entries only ever LEAVE. When a utility's Darwin branch lands, its line is
# deleted in the same change, and the lane starts holding it to GNU from then
# on. Nothing is ever added to buy a green lane: a new name here means a
# utility that used to pass on Darwin now does not, which is a regression to
# fix rather than to record.
#
# One test function per line, so the granularity is a utility rather than a
# case. The case counts behind these names, and the clusters they fall into,
# are in #9714; the largest by far is the listing code behind vdir, ls and
# dir, which is one program and 43% of the failures.
#
# Seeded from the first complete run of the catalogue on macos-15,
# 1411 failures over 14814 tests (PR #9676).
